description: Official Sealed BIS Knowledge Base Immutable Release v2 (479 chunks, 14 standard families / 18 versions, 25 catalog standards)

standards_distinction.discrepancy_resolution: The repository maintains 14 standard family records across 18 versions in SQLite 'standards'. The broader metadata catalog contains 25 standards. In ChromaDB, 479 chunks span 11 distinct Indian Standard families plus gazette orders. The historical '19 standards' claim referred to early draft documents prior to formal SQLite entity deduplication.
